status_observation_applicability.requirement: Status source_refs/digests must bind these exact definition and independent acceptance bytes. status_observation_applicability.original_source: S06 L3878 requires as_of/generation/source_digests/expiry for observation; it does not grant authority. This limited observation concerns actual accepted configuration definitions, while actual running state remains independently checked.

activation_conditions: Actual complete runtime acceptance and verified Owner publication before initialization of execution_current.
Initialize exactly these three independent values once under accepted live Root and scope; no borrowed or business-layer N/A generations.
Before every effect use fresh actual SQL values, exact accepted execution binding and current revocation; absent or mismatched rows refuse.
